meta.note: These strings supplement production reception. They do not modify or retroactively approve the frozen UI33-R3 files.

static.zh.import.fileLimit: 单个配置文件最大 8 MiB。选择、解密和预览都不会修改当前配置。
static.en.import.fileLimit: A configuration file can be up to 8 MiB. Choosing, decrypting, and previewing do not change the current configuration.
static.zh.export.passwordHelp: 口令需包含 12–128 个 Unicode 标量值，UTF-8 编码不超过 512 字节，不能全为空白或包含 U+0000。输入会原样使用，不会自动去除空格或做 Unicode 规范化；口令无法找回。
static.en.export.passwordHelp: Use 12–128 Unicode scalar values and no more than 512 UTF-8 bytes. The password cannot be all whitespace or contain U+0000. It is used exactly as entered, without trimming or Unicode normalization, and cannot be recovered.
static.zh.import.passwordHelp: 请输入导出时使用的原口令。口令需包含 12–128 个 Unicode 标量值，UTF-8 编码不超过 512 字节，不能全为空白或包含 U+0000；输入不会被去除空格或做 Unicode 规范化。界面、错误和日志不会显示口令或密钥。
static.en.import.passwordHelp: Enter the original export password. It must contain 12–128 Unicode scalar values, use no more than 512 UTF-8 bytes, and cannot be all whitespace or contain U+0000. It is not trimmed or Unicode-normalized. Passwords and keys are not shown in the interface, errors, or logs.
static.zh.export.passwordInvalid: 口令不符合文件保护要求。请检查长度、UTF-8 字节数、空白字符和 U+0000。
static.en.export.passwordInvalid: The password does not meet the file-protection requirements. Check its length, UTF-8 byte count, whitespace, and U+0000.
static.zh.import.passwordInvalid: 口令格式不符合要求。请使用导出时的原口令。
static.en.import.passwordInvalid: The password format is invalid. Use the original export password.
static.zh.result.notAppliedHelp: 服务器已确认本次操作没有替换配置。当前配置保持不变；如需重试，请重新选择文件、预览并确认。
static.en.result.notAppliedHelp: The server confirmed that this operation did not replace any configuration. Current configuration is unchanged. To try again, choose the file, preview, and confirm again.
static.zh.result.expiredHelp: 现在无法确认本次操作是否曾经生效。读取当前配置只能显示此刻状态，不能证明本次操作的结果；请勿据此重复提交旧操作。
static.en.result.expiredHelp: It is no longer possible to confirm whether this operation was applied. Reading current configuration shows only the current state and does not prove this operation’s result. Do not resubmit the old operation based on that snapshot.
static.zh.result.tokenInvalid: 无法验证本次恢复票据
static.en.result.tokenInvalid: This recovery token cannot be verified
static.zh.result.tokenInvalidHelp: 现在无法确认本次操作是否曾经生效。读取当前配置只能显示此刻状态，不能证明本次操作的结果；新的导入必须重新选择文件、预览并确认。
static.en.result.tokenInvalidHelp: It is not possible to confirm whether this operation was applied. Reading current configuration shows only the current state and does not prove this operation’s result. A new import must start with a new file selection, preview, and confirmation.
static.zh.result.superseded: 本次导入已成功，但当前配置后来又被修改。成功摘要属于本次操作；宿主页刷新后显示最新配置。
static.en.result.superseded: This import succeeded, but the current configuration was changed afterward. The success summary belongs to this operation; the refreshed host page shows the latest configuration.
static.zh.result.refreshFailed: 本次导入已成功，但宿主页未能读取最新配置。请重新读取页面配置；不要重复导入。
static.en.result.refreshFailed: This import succeeded, but the host page could not load the latest configuration. Read the page configuration again; do not repeat the import.
static.zh.confirm.previewExpired: 提交期限已过，原确认已失效。请重新选择文件并预览。
static.en.confirm.previewExpired: The submission deadline has passed and the previous confirmation is no longer valid. Choose the file and preview again.
static.zh.notice.nameGenerated: 名称已按既定规则自动生成。
static.en.notice.nameGenerated: The name was generated using the defined rule.
static.zh.notice.optionalValueCleared: 省略的可选值已清空，不会继承目标环境旧值。
static.en.notice.optionalValueCleared: The omitted optional value was cleared and does not inherit the old target value.
static.zh.notice.rewardQuantityZero: 未选择奖励道具，奖励数量按 0 应用。
static.en.notice.rewardQuantityZero: No reward item is selected, so the reward quantity is applied as 0.
static.zh.notice.checkinCurrentSelected: 源文件没有待生效签到规则，完整 current 规则将用于目标环境下一学习日。
static.en.notice.checkinCurrentSelected: The source file has no pending check-in rules, so the complete current rules will be used for the target environment’s next learning day.
static.zh.notice.languageFallback: 此语言内容为空；界面显示时回退到另一语言，不会生成或保存翻译。
static.en.notice.languageFallback: This language value is empty. The interface falls back to the other language without generating or saving a translation.
static.zh.notice.planNoModels: 此计划明确没有可用模型。
static.en.notice.planNoModels: This plan explicitly has no available models.
static.zh.notice.planNoLengths: 此计划明确没有可用长度。
static.en.notice.planNoLengths: This plan explicitly has no available lengths.
static.zh.notice.categoryCleared: 此文件将清空当前类别的活动配置；是否可提交仍以阻止项检查为准。
static.en.notice.categoryCleared: This file clears the active configuration for this category. Submission still depends on the blocker checks.
static.zh.notice.effectivePlanMayChange: 部分用户的实际计划可能改变。运行历史和已接受的进行中任务保持原快照。
static.en.notice.effectivePlanMayChange: Some users’ effective plans may change. Runtime history and accepted in-flight work keep their original snapshots.
static.zh.notice.levelMayDowngrade: 部分用户的当前等级可能降低；已达成和已领取历史保持。
static.en.notice.levelMayDowngrade: Some users’ current levels may decrease; achievement and claim history is preserved.
static.zh.notice.unknown: 此项还有配置提示，请核对完整预览。
static.en.notice.unknown: This item has an additional configuration notice. Review the complete preview.
static.en.error.reason.objectRequired: This field must be an object.
static.en.error.reason.outOfRange: The value is outside the allowed range.
static.zh.error.reason.immutableField: 此字段不能通过导入修改。
static.en.error.reason.immutableField: This field cannot be changed by import.
static.zh.error.reason.invalidReference: 引用的配置不存在或不可用。
static.en.error.reason.invalidReference: The referenced configuration does not exist or is unavailable.
static.zh.error.reason.protectedField: 此字段不允许出现在配置文件中。
static.en.error.reason.protectedField: This field is not allowed in the configuration file.
static.en.error.reason.unsupportedCharacter: The value contains an unsupported character.

templates.zh.preview.credentials: {count} 个连接均包含本次文件中的加密凭据
templates.en.preview.credentials: Encrypted credentials from this file are present for all {count} connections
templates.en.error.category: The file category is {fileCategory}, but the current category is {currentCategory}.
templates.zh.error.missingKey: {category} › {item} › API Key：文件未包含可解密的密钥。请从源环境重新导出含加密密钥的完整包。
templates.en.error.missingKey: {category} › {item} › API key: no decryptable key is present. Export a new complete package with encrypted keys from the source environment.
templates.zh.confirm.deadline: 请在 {deadline} 前提交（预览生成后 5 分钟）。超时必须重新预览；本次结果可查询至 {retainUntil}。
templates.en.confirm.deadline: Submit by {deadline}, 5 minutes after the preview was created. After that, preview again. This result can be checked until {retainUntil}.
templates.zh.result.lookupWindow: 本次结果可查询至 {retainUntil}（提交截止后 24 小时）。
templates.en.result.lookupWindow: This result can be checked until {retainUntil}, 24 hours after the submission deadline.
templates.zh.result.currentHelp: 读取时间：{readAt}。此快照只显示当前“{category}”配置，不能证明先前操作是否生效。
templates.en.result.currentHelp: Read at {readAt}. This snapshot shows only the current {category} configuration and does not prove whether the earlier operation was applied.
